title: Long-Hidden Flaws Patched in EPICS Research Facility Control Software
description: Four vulnerabilities in EPICS Base, a core component of the EPICS control system software used in particle accelerators and fusion labs, have been patched. These flaws, discovered by an autonomous system, can cause process crashes and potentially enable remote code execution. The most severe issue is an integer overflow leading to memory corruption. The vulnerabilities affect EPICS Base version 7.0.10 and earlier, with a fix available in version 7.0.11. Exploitation requires network access to specific EPICS services but no authentication or user interaction. No public exploitation has been reported.
